g.text: Each panel has its own y scale. FIFO wait is enqueue-to-load. Queued samples still waiting at the cutoff are censored. Rings mark limited tail samples.
Coverage counts due fixed bytes and caps due assured bytes at MFU-visible demand. A missing coverage point means the denominator was zero.
